He writes the column headers using writer.writerow(['ItemId', 'ItemName', 'Quantity', 'UnitPrice']). To insert multiple inventory shipment rows at once from a nested list of records, he uses writer.writerows(shipment_data).
Later, to search for low-stock items, he reads the file using csv.reader, checks if int(row[2]) < 20, and prints alerts for restock.
